children: Tenon Medical, Inc. said the USPTO issued 8 new patents so far in FY26, bringing its total to 38 U.S. patents and 9 international, with 31 applications pending. The IP covers its Catamaran SI Joint Fusion System.
Expands protection; can support pricing power and deter rivals.
Broad portfolio may strengthen competitive moat in SI fusion.
Signals pipeline of further protections that could extend moat.
Core product protection underpins adoption and revenue aims.
Large TAM frames potential upside if adoption improves.

This extends Tenon’s IP build-out following Catamaran’s 2022 launch and the 2025 SImmetry+ acquisition—an early- to mid-stage moat story. For a bigger catalyst, watch for regulatory clearances, product launches, surgeon adoption data, and revenue traction.
